effect_description_eng:
[Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
[Start of Your Main Phase] By trashing 1 card with the [Hybrid] or [Ten Warriors] trait in your hand, gain 1 memory.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Trash the bottom digivolution card of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, if your opponent has no Digimon with digivolution cards, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
